fusions.name: Lunge and Bite
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away for a weapon strike that deals 13 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pack Snap
fusions.desc: A snapping strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Rallying Bark
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Trained Hound
fusions.desc: Calls a trained hound familiar that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.
